'''Sisla''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Along with a group of fellow Devaronians, he once tracked the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Resh (Sullustan)|Resh]] to a warehouse in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
